name: Fortunatus Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Fortunato was baptized on 6 March 1822, son of Nicola Ferlaino and Agata Moraca; his godfather came from neighbouring Conflenti (S1). He married Rosa (Tommasina) Moraca, daughter of the late Francesco Moraca and Francesca Orlando, on 15 June 1851 (S2). Their children in the baptism index are Gennaro (1855), Raffaela (1858), Marianna (1865), Giuseppe Antonio (1868), a first Leopoldo (1870, died at 5 months) and John's ancestor Leopoldo (1871) (S4). Fortunato was buried at San Mango on 28 April 1901, aged 82 (S3). He thus outlived his wife and saw his son leave for Pennsylvania.
